# Will of D.

![](../../assets/mods/hakirework.png){ .entry-page-icon }

[All bloodlines](index.md)

A killing blow can leave you standing at 2 HP, clearing Poison and Wither. The World Government will turn you away. Follow the [Inherited Will quests](../../reference/quests/r_traits.md).
